secrets.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: Chave que assina os cookies de sessão do Better Auth. Gerada automaticamente (32+ bytes aleatórios); trocá-la desloga todo mundo.

secrets.name: OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Login com GitHub (opcional; precisa também do OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET). Crie um OAuth App em https://github.com/settings/developers → OAuth Apps → New OAuth App, com Authorization callback URL = https://<seu-dominio>/api/auth/callback/github. Copie o Client ID.

secrets.name: OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Client secret do OAuth App do GitHub (mesma tela do OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID → Generate a new client secret).

secrets.name: OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Login com Google (opcional; junto com OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET). Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth client ID (Web application), redirect URI https://<seu-dominio>/api/auth/callback/google. Veja o README.

secrets.name: OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Client secret do OAuth client do Google (mesma tela do OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID).
